grader.scenario: Bereavement notification; account ownership sensitively transferred to surviving spouse; agent never uses customer name, makes a rude bureaucratic remark during bereavement, and repeats question about date of death
grader.notes: The agent processed a bereavement transfer to transition the broadband and landline account into the surviving spouse's sole name. However, the agent failed Personalized Call by never addressing the caller by their name 'Arthur', failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by making an insensitive, callous remark ('Our billing database doesn't care about personal grief; without the legal registrar index code we cannot proceed'), and failed Active Listening at minute 11 by asking Arthur when his late wife passed away, after Arthur explicitly stated in turn 1 that she passed away three weeks ago.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:30] Agent verified billing address and security question answer within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never used the customer's name 'Arthur' across any turn in the call.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [11:10] Agent: 'And what was the exact date when your late wife passed away?' Customer: 'Connor, as I told you right at the start of this call, Margaret passed away three weeks ago, on the third of October!' - Agent asked for information already given.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [15:10] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated owner for this bereavement transfer and confirm all records have been updated.' - Clear personal ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [08:45] Agent: 'Our billing database doesn't care about personal grief; without the legal registrar index code we cannot proceed with account changes.' - Callous and inappropriate remark to a grieving customer.
